Contested escrow with a bounty makes forgery costly: an identity locks 240 units for 15 epochs, disputable in 3 epochs on evidence, its lock as hard to fake as jade.

Nine jurors rule in 2 epochs; forgery slashes 80%, pays the challenger 25% of the slash as nectar, bars re-entry 12 epochs, and rewards vest 20 per clean epoch after the tide of disputes.

At scale: 1,000 fakes lock 240,000 units; 30% caught: 57,600 slashed, 14,400 to challengers.
